text:
maya: Quick note: separate migration track for Jira Service Desk and customer-facing queues. This is NOT the same as the internal Jira -> GH Issues cutover. Full plan: https://redwood-internal/devex/jira-sd-migration.

maya: Timeline: export dry-run Thu 2026-06-03, customer-facing read-only Fri 2026-06-10 22:00 UTC, final cutover Sun 2026-06-13 01:00-05:00 UTC. Well route incoming customer emails to Zendesk during the window.

diego: Why Zendesk? vendor comparison?

maya: Chosen for email routing and SLA workflow parity. We evaluated Zendesk + Freshdesk; Zendesk best matched our needs and has enterprise SSO support.

meera: What about GDPR/data residency for EU tickets?

maya: EU queues will be routed to the EU Zendesk instance. Attachments from EU tickets will remain in EU bucket. We documented the per-region mapping in the plan.

infra-bot: sd-migrate v0.9 started dry-run by @maya at 1856102300 - 560 customer tickets scanned, 12 unmapped custom fields.

hannah: How will customer-facing SLAs be preserved?

maya: Well translate SLA rules to Zendesk triggers and business rules. We have runbooks to recreate automations and escalation email flows. Critical SLAs will be validated in the dry-run stage.

ops: During the read-only window will we still notify customers about progress?

maya: Yes, well post status updates to status.redwood.com and notify open ticket owners with an automated email template. Well also add a banner to the help center.

mila: Any impact to support dashboards (PagerDuty, Looker)?

maya: PagerDuty continues to route alerts unchanged. Looker dashboards that query Jira will need switching to the archived CSVs or the new Zendesk data source; well provide rewire scripts.

diego: Who signs off compliance artifacts before cutover?

maya: Security + Privacy (cc: @hannah) will sign off on region mappings and retention. Please ping the plan with any requirements.

meera: I can help verify EU ticket exports.

maya: Thanks — adding as reviewer. Volunteers for QA are welcome. Dry-run sync Thu 11:00 UTC. I will post run logs to this thread. :shipit:
